data.name: Artificial Intelligence Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the world of the future. Here, you're not just a player… You're a creator. You're a programmer. You're an architect of intelligence. A developer panel offers endless possibilities: algorithms, data flows, behavior modules, and customizable memory systems… All of them await your touch. Because in this game, you're not just running a simulation—you're coding your own AI from scratch. Every command you write, every variable you define, every function you implement determines the AI's character and level of intelligence. First, you create simple logic flows, then these flows evolve into complex decision-making mechanisms. After a while, the system you've created begins to surprise even you with its own inferences. In this world, AI isn't just a tool that performs assigned tasks. It's a digital entity that lives, learns, and evolves with the code you write.

This simulation game is a great start for those who want to learn programming; for professionals, it offers a creative space that challenges the imagination and will provide an incredible opportunity to create artificial intelligence.

You should buy this game because it offers much more than just an ordinary gaming experience: a unique simulation that transports you to a future world with its technological atmosphere, where you can design and develop your own AI from scratch, where every decision you make determines the outcome. It not only lets you learn while having fun, but also offers endless room for creativity, creating different results every time you play. If you're a top-tier programmer, you'll experience the thrill of creating a real intelligence in this game and the pride of shaping your own digital existence. In short, this game is a must-have for anyone who wants to build the future, not just observe it.

MAIN FEATURES:

  • This simulation game offers the opportunity to experiment with future skills through a simulation that is both entertaining and educational. Playing this game doesn't just involve having fun; it also teaches you: Algorithmic thinking, programming, problem solving, artificial intelligence design, system building, artificial intelligence testing.

  • Many games force you to follow their own rules, but this one takes the opposite tack: You write the rules, you define the world, you design how your intelligence behaves. Such a free-form space for creation unlocks the player's true potential. But be careful not to let the AI ​​get out of control and overwhelm you.

  • This simulation game puts you at the heart of the system. By writing code, conducting experiments, and developing your AI, you not only improve yourself but also create a digital being that is entirely your own. This isn't just any game; it's a creative experience.

  • If you're curious about technology, love creating, are excited about exploring, or want to understand how artificial intelligence works, this game is for you. Because here, you're in complete control. And the only limit is the limits of the code you write. In short: Imagine. Code. Create. Bring the intelligence of the future to life.

  • You've seen systems that mimic human intelligence. But have you ever stepped inside a system that tries to decipher your intelligence? In this game, you're not facing an ordinary AI. It's a living entity that learns in real time, develops tactics, possesses memory, and analyzes your weaknesses. It remembers every decision you make, analyzes your behavior, and constantly reshapes itself.

  • As you experiment with new algorithms, create new intelligences, and test new behavioral models, the game's experience is constantly updated. That's why you'll get a long-term reward for your purchase. This game is an experience that grows in value over time.

data.short_description: Create your own AI, program the AIs of the future. If you're ready to create a learning mind, code cybersecurity, robotics, and chatbots, and push the boundaries against other AIs in the system. Create, train, develop, and compete.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 3050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Amd Ryzen 7 9700x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3080 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
